synth.notes:
Blocks (10) move as a mirrored pair on a 4-cell grid: A1/A2 move both up/down, A3 spreads them apart, A4 pulls them together. A move only happens if every destination cell is floor (5) in rows 1-62.
Clicking an inactive marker (9) arms the blocks (10->1) and makes that marker the active one (11); the old active one goes back to 9. Clicking an armed player (1) disarms. Any other click, and A5, changes nothing.
In armed mode, A1-A4 move the active marker's 4x4 cell (the marker bbox grown by 1) under the same floor guard.
HUD: 0-bars on row 0 (growing from the right) and row 63 (growing from the left), width 3(a+1)//7. a counts every action this level, including no-ops. It is kept as hidden state only while the incoming frame equals the last output; otherwise a=0 if there is no bar, else the largest a that gives that width.
Not confirmed: win/level-complete behaviour, and A7, were never observed.
